I'm a postdoc at MPIM, where I study homotopy theory and algebraic topology, with particular emphasis on equivariant and algebraic considerations.

I believe that the best mathematical community is one whose population is primarily selected for by interest and effort. I endorce Federico Ardila axioms.

Recent updates:
